class.name: JobSystemHandle
class.description: Returned by [method JobSystem.schedule], [method JobSystem.schedule_for] and [method JobSystem.schedule_parallel_for]. Call [method complete] to block until the job finishes, or [method is_completed] to poll. The underlying job handle is released when this object is freed.

method.name: complete
method.description: Blocks until the job (and its dependencies) complete.

method.name: is_completed
method.description: Returns whether the job has finished.
